# windows-sddl

> Pure-Rust, cross-platform parsing and construction of Windows self-relative
> security descriptors, ACLs, ACEs, SIDs, GUIDs, and Active Directory rights.

- [README](https://github.com/icedracon/windows-sddl/blob/main/README.md)
- [API documentation](https://docs.rs/windows-sddl)
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/icedracon/win32-min/blob/master/ECOSYSTEM.md)
- [AD rights table](https://docs.rs/windows-sddl/latest/windows_sddl/rights/)

This crate accepts binary self-relative `SECURITY_DESCRIPTOR` bytes and works
without Windows or FFI. Do not claim complete support for the textual SDDL
language. Malformed and truncated binary inputs return errors rather than
panicking.
